properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.enabled
properties.description: Enable the explicit CPF Redis distributed-cache provider. Redis and Valkey providers are mutually exclusive.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.key-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for CPF cache, lock, and fencing-token keys.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.invalidation-channel
properties.description: Redis-protocol pub/sub channel used as the fast invalidation signal; durable JDBC invalidation remains authoritative.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.default-ttl
properties.description: Default cache TTL used by convenience consumers.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.required
properties.description: Whether provider health must fail readiness when durable invalidation is unavailable.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.tls
properties.description: Operational metadata indicating the configured Redis-protocol connection is TLS protected. Connection details remain Spring Data Redis properties.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.maximum-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum encoded application payload accepted by CPF cache operations.

properties.name: cpf.data.cache.redis.scan-count
properties.description: SCAN batch hint used for bounded namespace eviction.
